The Terrace by AYANA

Condominium in Layan (Choeng Thale, Thalang)
HomeSaleThe Terrace by AYANA

Official teaser artwork from the developer. Architectural renders and floor plans have not been published by the developer yet.

Project overview

The Terrace by AYANA is a new condominium development in Layan, in the Choeng Thale subdistrict of Thalang on Phuket's north-west coast, by AYANA Phuket, the brand of T.H. Group Phuket, which also develops AYANA Heights, AYANA Soluna Villas and AYANA Commons. The developer describes it as a hillside residence built in tiers: each level steps back from the one below so that every residence looks out over the sea, the forest or the hills, with terrace-level pools.

The first launch price lists, dated 27 November 2026 and marked subject to release confirmation, cover 50 units: 14 in Zone B and 36 in Zone C. They are compact units of 32 to 48 sqm indoors, from the ground floor to the sixth floor, priced from THB 3,300,000 to THB 6,899,904. Several ground-floor units have a private garden of 5 to 34 sqm, and some Zone B units have direct pool access.

Agents report a total of about 604 units in three low-rise blocks, studio to two-bedroom layouts of up to about 96 sqm, and facilities such as an infinity pool, a gym, a padel court and a rooftop bar. The developer has not yet published these details, the construction timeline, ownership terms or fees, so we show them as indicative only. Ask us for the official price list and the latest availability.

Frequently asked questions

What is The Terrace by AYANA?

The Terrace by AYANA is a new hillside condominium in Layan, Phuket, by AYANA Phuket (T.H. Group Phuket). It is built in tiers so that each residence faces the sea, the forest or the hills.

Where is The Terrace by AYANA located?

On a hillside in Layan, in the Choeng Thale subdistrict of Thalang on Phuket's north-west coast, near Layan and Bang Tao beaches. Agents give about 1.2 km to Layan Beach; the developer has not published an exact address.

How much do units at The Terrace by AYANA cost?

The developer launch price lists of 27 November 2026 range from THB 3,300,000 (unit C-133, 32 sqm) to THB 6,899,904 (unit B-511, 32 sqm plus 8 sqm outdoor, pool access). Prices are subject to release confirmation.

What unit sizes are available?

The launch units are 32 to 48 sqm indoors, and some ground-floor units add a private garden of 5 to 34 sqm. The price lists do not state bedrooms; agents describe studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom formats of up to about 96 sqm for the whole project.

Which zones are on sale?

The first launch covers Zone B (14 units) and Zone C (36 units), 50 units in total. Information on other zones has not been published.

When will The Terrace by AYANA be completed?

The developer has not yet announced the construction start or completion date.

Can foreigners buy at The Terrace by AYANA?

Ownership terms and the foreign quota have not yet been published by the developer. In Thailand, foreigners can usually own condominium units freehold within a building's 49% foreign quota; ask us to confirm the terms for a specific unit.

How can I get the latest price list?

Send us a WhatsApp message with the unit number or zone you are interested in and we will send the current price list and availability.
